Floods Inundation (8-10 Sept'14)
Pre and Post Flood Scenarios

1) Brief Hydrological and hydrodynamic modeling study has been carried out on the Adyar and Cooum River floods for approximate quantification of flood discharges and to forecast the flood discharges for next 2 days (up to 08 Dec 2015) using space based input and IMD, CPC/TRMM rainfall data. Real-Time Flood Assessment Report :07Dec2015

Disclaimer:
1. Real-time flood forecasting is done for Adyar and Cooum River Catchments using satellite based rainfall products such as TRMM+CPC and IMD rainfall forecast data hence, it may not be very accurate.This forecast can be used to assess the overall flood scenario in the catchment.
2. Flood inundation simulations are done using 10m resolution CARTO DEM with height accuracy of + or - 3m, hence the simulations are approximate. This is to give an approximate idea on the areas that got inundated during maximum flood condition.
